card.title: How To Fix an iPhone 17 Air That Randomly Restarts

source.title: How To Fix an iPhone 17 Air That Randomly Restarts

claims.statement: iPhone Air Sensor Array 33554432 (0x2000000) = wireless charging flex on the back glass.
58720256 (0x3800000) = charging port flex (also check the air pressure sensor is connected).

procedure: Test the flagged flex with a known-good OEM part; diode-check FPC.
Check air pressure sensor connection for 0x3800000.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
